verdict.rationale: Fathom's API reference pages embed OpenAPI-style definitions per endpoint (e.g. 'summary: List teams operationId: listTeams'), and an llms.txt index is served. However, probes of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404, so no single downloadable spec file was found. missing for 10: a documented, downloadable complete OpenAPI file at a stable URL, evidence the spec covers all endpoints, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
